description: Source configuration for the TheAIReadyist Executive Signal Agent v1. The agent ingests headline-level metadata (title, URL, source, published date, short excerpt) from public RSS/Atom feeds only. It never fetches paywalled article bodies and never bypasses access controls. Disabled sources are configured for future enablement but were not feed-verified during the v1 build — confirm the feed URL returns valid RSS/Atom before flipping `enabled` to true.
